qa_safeguard_expected_cutoff_boundary: Includes messages at the cutoff and excludes older ones.
qa_safeguard_expected_checkpoint_overlap: Returns only unsaved suggestions on a repeat scan.
qa_safeguard_expected_partial_quota: Keeps accepted results and defers remaining AI work.
qa_safeguard_expected_rolling_expiry: Allows AI work again after the reduced window expires.
qa_safeguard_expected_shared_batch_live: Shares one SMS AI allowance between batch and live SMS.
qa_safeguard_expected_burst_limit: Refuses repeated provider starts inside the short burst window.
qa_safeguard_expected_history_cooldown: Disables history rescan after admitted AI work.
qa_safeguard_expected_oversized_candidat: Skips one oversized message before simulated AI work.
qa_safeguard_expected_response_validity: Makes only complete, recognized provider results reviewable.
qa_safeguard_expected_negative_three_str: Makes a third valid AI-negative outcome terminal.
qa_safeguard_expected_terminal_fresh_ins: Keeps terminal AI state after a simulated fresh install.
qa_safeguard_expected_trusted_local_reco: Allows an exact trusted local match without AI.
qa_safeguard_expected_account_switch: Keeps safeguard state isolated to the active user.
qa_safeguard_expected_consent_required: Refuses AI work before allowance or provider activity without consent.
qa_safeguard_expected_prompt_token_basel: Rejects input that exceeds the local token boundary.
qa_safeguard_must_not_cutoff_boundary: An older message becomes a review suggestion.
qa_safeguard_must_not_checkpoint_overlap: A saved suggestion returns after the repeat scan.
qa_safeguard_must_not_partial_quota: Accepted suggestions disappear when AI capacity is reached.
qa_safeguard_must_not_rolling_expiry: An expired rolling limit keeps blocking AI work.
qa_safeguard_must_not_shared_batch_live: Batch and live SMS use separate SMS AI budgets.
qa_safeguard_must_not_burst_limit: A refused burst request reaches simulated AI.
qa_safeguard_must_not_history_cooldown: History rescan stays enabled during cooldown.
qa_safeguard_must_not_oversized_candidat: An oversized message reaches simulated AI.
qa_safeguard_must_not_negative_three_str: A terminal AI-negative fingerprint is submitted again.
qa_safeguard_must_not_terminal_fresh_ins: Fresh install sends a synchronized terminal fingerprint to AI.
qa_safeguard_must_not_trusted_local_reco: Trusted local recovery starts simulated AI work.
qa_safeguard_must_not_account_switch: Another user's safeguard state changes this run.
qa_safeguard_must_not_consent_required: AI work begins without current consent.
qa_safeguard_purpose_oversized_candidate: Validates safe handling for oversized candidates.
qa_safeguard_purpose_partial_quota: Validates partial results when the scan allowance is reached.
qa_safeguard_purpose_cutoff_boundary: Validates messages at the lookback boundary.
qa_safeguard_purpose_shared_batch_live: Validates shared batch and live allowance.
qa_safeguard_purpose_terminal_fresh_inst: Validates terminal outcomes after a fresh install.
